---

The _black king_ is a _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [ashen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2550) [blunderbuss](/Weapons.aspx?ID=196)_. While the dark metal frame is still pleasant to look at, this design prioritizes destructive power over aesthetic appeal. This specialized blunderbuss has a [scatter](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1671) radius of 20 feet instead of 10, and all [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150) damage it deals is negative damage instead of physical. Due to the risk of collateral damage, this weapon is typically only used by the especially foolhardy or reckless.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You unleash a blast of draining flame, dealing 5d6 fire damage and 5d6 negative damage to all creatures in a 60 foot cone (DC 34 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). Creatures who fail their saving throw are [knocked back](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 5 feet. Creatures who critically fail are knocked back 10 feet and fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).

</column>
